States the prerequisites (schema and reference data in source control, per-developer instances, migration-based over state-based delivery because data motion outweighs merge-conflict convenience) that make a real database testable at all.
States the one-way indicator - hard-to-test code reliably signals poor quality (usually tight coupling), but easy-to-test code does not establish good design.
